name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Cherry Mango
description:
Discover the exotic fusion of Cherry Mango in our Double-Stacked BITEZ gummies! These delightful treats blend the tart richness of cherries with the tropical sweetness of mango, creating a tantalizing flavor experience. Each gummy is powerfully infused with a precise blend of Detla-8, Delta-9, and THCP, delivering a potent 1,000mg dose per piece. Enclosed in each package are two of these vibrant, flavor-packed gummies, crafted to perfection to ensure a delicious and exhilarating adventure with every bite.

Cherry Mango layers juicy Cherry with tropical Mango flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
